headline: M2: 22-case replacement suitability review ready.
detail: Human suitability review of the original 100 core evidence packets is complete: 78 were suitable and 22 unsuitable. A deterministic replacement pass evaluated all 50 reserve candidates and staged 22 provenance-preserving replacement evidence packets. The replacement set is now ready for human suitability screening before the benchmark advances to historical-context assembly and relationship adjudication.
next_gate: Complete human suitability screening of the 22 staged replacement packets, then assemble historical context and begin relationship adjudication for Benchmark v0.1.
public_private_boundary: Only aggregate research-progress counts are public. Private evidence packets, replacement packet contents, and raw operational records are not exposed by this status artifact.
